name: Youth volunteers at Summer Playtime and Summer Day Camps
org: M-NCPPC Department of Parks and Recreation, Prince George's County
what_you_do: Volunteer at a Summer Playtime program (age 14) or a Summer Day Camp (age 15) for 12 to 15 hours a week and earn student service learning hours.
who_can_apply: Youth must reach the required age on or before May 31: 14 for Summer Playtime, 15 for Summer Day Camps. Youth cannot volunteer at a site where a younger sibling or child is a registered participant. Ages 15 and older need a criminal background history check.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Approved for Prince George's County Public Schools Student Service Learning hours.
deadline_text: Volunteer applications are accepted online from March 1-May 1. The page gives no year.
how_to_apply: Sign up through the Volunteer Opportunities page of pgparks.com. Each youth may volunteer at only one Summer Playtime or Summer Day Camp site. Transportation is not provided.
notes: Dates for the 2027 season are not posted on the page. Unpaid volunteering, so no work permit.
